tests.name: one versioned allowlist retains decision evidence and excludes bodies, credentials and raw errors
all internal lifecycle names normalize and public terminal aliases retain their meaning
invalid explicit identities cannot collapse into anonymous sessions or foreground requests
timings, enums, counts and model transitions are bounded without retaining invalid payloads
usage and pricing normalizers preserve valid counts and never erase malformed pricing into standard prices
legacy decisions upgrade without claiming success and foreground excerpts use 500 Unicode code points
metadata-only and background records never persist prompt text
outcomes require explicit completion status and preserve confirmed models separately from selection
savings metadata and coverage retain only finite amounts and bounded known reasons
malformed inputs cannot throw or traverse arbitrary objects
selection and confirmation are distinct and requested client models never become actual models
routing and idle states label confirmed history; capability guards do not display classifier tiers as models
an observed model with unknown completion never becomes a green ready response
prompt continuity displays its pinned model separately from the latest classifier choice
Ollama routes, cache hits and fallbacks identify their evaluator while keeping Claude model confirmation separate
unknown evaluator metadata cannot leak into the terminal or change Claude model labels
sessions are isolated, including absent session IDs, and malformed stdin awaits status
fallbacks, HTTP and SSE errors, cancellation, and dead or stale routers remain visible
narrow lines drop context and routine phase before the model guard
API context uses the confirmed model window and exposes a different CLI limit
context labels historical usage and clears it after compaction or a new unmeasured completion
unknown capacities and malformed or mismatched usage never imply API headroom
untrusted model and error strings cannot inject terminal controls or extra lines
savings use session estimates rather than client cost, including cache-weighted values
savings show partial coverage and unavailable usage without manufacturing a zero
unpriced request counts are optional and never displace the selected model or guard
savings support extra cost, tiny amounts, and a zero baseline without infinity
savings are isolated by exact session, including anonymous and prototype names
malformed savings cannot inject controls, dollar claims, NaN, or infinity
narrow status lines retain guards before optional estimates and preserve every estimate qualifier
fallback and error explanations take priority over savings on narrow lines
compact fallback lines retain the cause and actual model before routine phase, estimates, and context
HTTP fallback causes show safe classifier status separately from upstream errors
fallback causes are allowlisted and cannot masquerade as a successful classification
evaluator saturation remains an explained fallback rather than a classifier decision
tiny fallback lines fit without dropping selection qualifiers or reverting to a success phase
Auto floors retain selected model and explanation before savings, context and timing at common widths
unknown continuity cannot present an inherited reason as a known pin
compatibility reasons explain a guard without exposing raw metadata
Unicode model names fit terminal cell budgets while retaining complete selection qualifiers

limits: Original40 pure definitions and assertions execute. Native expected values preserve undefined-vs-value result kind. Overflow JSON preserves Infinity for document-based telemetry normalization. Accessors/cycles/nonplain objects/undefined arguments and unsupported nonfinite status inputs are explicit skipped calls. Default PID liveness is captured as true; injected liveness callbacks remain skipped. Missing timestamp uses captured injected now. Executable statusline31 is excluded. Capture alone is not native parity evidence.
